props.title: Flue agent setup audit — incident A

props.content:
Job: give an operator a single-page, evidence-backed diagnosis of why setup/dispatch attempts become terminal or “uncertain”, where replays are safe/unsafe, and which focused tests/fixes will prevent recurrence.

Key summary (short):
- Admission → queue consumer → prepare workspace → stage attachments → begin dispatch → dispatch → ledger finalization. See detailed flow and exact file:line citations below. (Primary evidence: src/tasks/processor.ts, src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts, src/cloudflare.ts.)
- Two failure classes: pre-dispatch failures (safe to retry; ledger.releaseQueueEvent is used) and post-dispatch failures (unsafe to replay; code returns 'uncertain' and the queue terminalizes). See processor catch paths and cloudflare queue logic.

props.content:
Narrow fixes (implement in this order):

P0 (immediate): add unit+integration tests for processTaskMessage failure modes and failTaskMessage.
  - Tests: processTaskMessage success, pre-dispatch failure -> ledger.releaseQueueEvent called, post-dispatch failure -> return 'uncertain' and failUncertainDispatch. (See src/tasks/processor.ts:259-405; desired tests in src/tasks/processor.test.ts.)

P1: add a reconciliation path for dispatch receipts: persist dispatchId atomically (or enqueue reconciliation job) when dispatch(...) returns but ledger writes fail (src/tasks/processor.ts:369-389; src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:1278-1294).

P1: record richer diagnostics in protected task_activity entries (dispatchId, sandbox logs) so operators can reconcile ambiguous states (src/tasks/processor.ts:369-405; src/observability/task-activity.ts).

P1: bounded retries around ledger.markQueueDispatched/completeQueueEvent immediately after a successful dispatch to reduce false 'uncertain' terminals.
